# Clean & Shiny

> Insured and bonded residential and commercial cleaning service in Chicago, Illinois and surrounding suburbs. Run by Maria Vazquez, in business for over 10 years and grown by referral. Two teams, six cleaners. Legal name: Clean & Shiny LLC. Also written as "Clean and Shiny".

## Services

### Standard (regular) residential cleaning — from $180
Takes 2–4 hours depending on the size of the home. Includes dusting of ceiling fans, vents, window casings and all furniture; vacuuming and mopping throughout; full bathroom clean; kitchen countertops, backsplash, cabinet exteriors, microwave, stovetop and appliance exteriors. Interiors of the refrigerator, oven and cabinets are available as add-ons.

### Deep cleaning — from $280
Takes 3–5 hours with a team of three. Everything in a standard cleaning, plus baseboards, walls and doors, interior windows, corners and edges, under and behind furniture, built-up grime in kitchen and bath, light fixtures and switch plates.

### Move-in / move-out cleaning — from $350
Takes 3–6 hours with a team of three, depending on condition. Everything in standard and deep cleaning, plus inside all cabinets and drawers, inside the oven, inside the refrigerator, closets and storage spaces, and interior windows and tracks. The garage can be added.

### Post-construction cleaning — from $400
Takes 4–6 hours with a team of three, depending on size and condition. Full deep clean plus construction grime removal, adhesive and paste residue, paint spots and overspray, removal of leftover debris, and dust from vents, sills and fixtures. The garage can be added.

### Commercial cleaning — $0.35 per square foot
Takes 1–3 hours depending on the size of the space. Offices, storefronts and workspaces. Includes dusting from top to bottom, trash removal, window cleaning, vacuuming and mopping, restrooms, sinks, and break and lunch areas. Additional tasks can be added. Recurring schedules available.

## Add-ons
Available with any service and priced together with the quote, based on size and condition: interior oven cleaning; interior refrigerator and freezer; inside cabinets and drawers; change of bed linens; interior window cleaning; wall cleaning and washing; hard water stain removal; floor tile and grout; pantry and closet organization; garage; outdoor patio; exterior pressure washing.

## Supplies
Clean & Shiny brings its own supplies and equipment to every job. Clients may request clean, plant-based products, or ask that their own products be used instead, at no extra charge.

Final prices depend on the condition, size and distance of the location. Quotes are free.

## Service area
Chicago and surrounding suburbs, within about 40 miles.

## Insurance
Fully insured and bonded.

## Hours
Monday through Saturday, 6am to 5pm.

## Payment
Cash, Zelle, Cash App, card, and check.
